routes.reason: Accept as corrected. R2 owns formal models and generic fibres, and R3 coherent sheaves and Kiehl-type finiteness. The paper's Kassaei–Bartenwerfer bounded sections, finite étale images and strict neighbourhoods, the finiteness criterion 4.1.8 and the identity principle are statements about those objects. R0, which constructs finite and étale maps of rigid spaces, is added to the stages, as in PAPER-PILLONI-20's accepted route 7 ([R0, R2, R3]). The maximum modulus principle that Proposition 3.2.1 uses joins as item 42. The route is frontier-safe: these statements need nothing from the Part II.

Accept as corrected. As submitted this was a source of FiniteFlatGroupsAndIntegralPadicHodgeTheory R07.1, but Fargues's degree already has an accepted owner. PAPER-BOXER-PILLONI-26's route 12 sends the degree, its divisor and the comparison for generic isomorphisms ([Far10] §3, Cor. 3) to HodgeTateAndCanonicalSubgroups T0, and PAPER-BOXER-CALEGARI-GEE-PILLONI-21's route 13 does the same with its items 144 and 264. Both routes are accepted. T0's text builds on the Barsotti–Tate API of R07.1–R07.2 and says 'do not define a second p-divisible group'. Re-routed to T0, where item 10 coalesces with theirs; additivity in short exact sequences, used on p. 992, is added to the item. T0 needs A3–A4, R2 and C4, all upstream of the Part II that imports it.

Accept as corrected. M2 owns the smooth good-level PEL model, and Wedhorn's density theorem for its special fibre ([Wed99, 1.6.3]) is a statement about it; no other layer owns ordinary-locus density for general PEL data. As submitted, item 12 also carried Remark 1.5.1's Iwahori-level claims: that X_Iw(0) is non-empty, and that the ordinary locus is dense at Iwahori level exactly when p splits completely in F. Those need the model X_Iw of item 7, routed downstream to the Part II, so they are now item 43 there. Lemma 1.1.4 (item 3), the linear algebra of PEL signatures under Hypothesis 1.1.1, moved here from the Part II, and M0, which owns the real signature data and the reflex field, joins the stages.

Accept as corrected. C5 owns integral PEL compactifications and 'higher p-level normalizations'. The accepted extractions of Pilloni (2020, route 17), Boxer–Calegari–Gee–Pilloni (2021, route 33) and Calegari–Geraghty (2020, route 14) send Köcher principles to C3–C5. As submitted, items 34 and 36 were stated for the moduli model X_Iw of item 7, which is routed to the Part II, downstream of C5. The paper itself builds X^S_Iw as a compactification of a normalization in an auxiliary Siegel variety ([Lan16, Example 13.12]), and uses the normality of X_Iw only to identify the two (p. 1009). So items 34 and 36 are restated for the normalization model, and the identification is item 35, now missing and in the Part II.
